scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run dev -w @bdsgiatot/api" "npm run dev -w @bdsgiatot/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bdsgiatot/api && npm run build -w @bdsgiatot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @bdsgiatot/api && npm run typecheck -w @bdsgiatot/web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run start -w @bdsgiatot/api" "npm run start -w @bdsgiatot/web"
